basic_details.job_title: IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai)
basic_details.post_name: Research Associate-III and Junior Research Fellow

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Electrical Engineering/Electrical and Electronics Engineering with NET/GATE or equivalent national level exam for JRF, Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or 3 years research/teaching/design experience after ME/M.Tech with SCI paper for RA-III
qualification.details: Research Associate-III: Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree or having 3 years of research, teaching and design development experience after ME/M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Computer Science and Computer Application, with at least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. Junior Research Fellow: Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Electrical Engineering/ Electrical and Electronics Engineering selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE or through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc.

salary_details.details: Research Associate-III: Rs. 67,000/- per month Junior Research Fellow: Rs. 37,000/- per month

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Bhilai Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Bhilai to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Bhilai Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Associate-III: Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree or having 3 years of research, teaching and design development experience after ME/M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Computer Science and Computer Application, with at least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. Junior Research Fellow: Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Electrical Engineering/ Electrical and Electronics Engineering selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE or through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Associate-III: Rs. 67,000/- per month Junior Research Fellow: Rs. 37,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Bhilai Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Bhilai to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Bhilai recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the IIT Bhilai Research Associate-III and Junior Research Fellow posts is 09 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate-III and Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with 1 post for Research Associate-III and 1 post for Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: For the Junior Research Fellow position, a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Electrical Engineering/Electrical and Electronics Engineering selected through NET/GATE or equivalent national level exams is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Associate-III post is Rs. 67,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the IIT Bhilai recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these posts is Online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIT Bhilai recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online/Offline Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Bhilai located?
faq.answer: IIT Bhilai is located in Bhilai, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 491001.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with a Master's degree apply for the Research Associate-III position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a Master's degree (ME/M.Tech) in relevant fields and 3 years of research, teaching, and design development experience, along with a SCI paper, are eligible for the Research Associate-III position.
